name: Sohar
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Sohar was a man from the tribe of Asher, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Helem (also called Hotham) and belonged to one of the prominent families in the tribe of Asher. His descendants are listed among the brave warriors in Asher's genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Sofah is listed as one of the sons of Helem in the detailed genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Warrior Families of Asher
keyEvents.description: Sofah and his descendants were counted among the brave warriors and heads of the families within the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Descendants Recorded
keyEvents.description: The sons of Sofah are named as Suah, Harnefer, Sual, Beri, and Jimra, all of whom contributed to the numbers and strength of the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Asher in the Census
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher, to which Sofah belonged, was counted among the tribes of Israel and had significant military strength.
